card.name: Punctuation inside census and listing text
card.fires_on: Decimal points and spaces or numbers inside fixed-format lines, such as census sex-ratio sentences and file listings. Also ellipses and sentence starts at joins between scraped text snippets.

modes.label: Census decimals
modes.description: The period inside or after a number in census sex-ratio sentences.
modes.example: For every 100 females there were 84<<.>>9 males.

modes.label: File listing fields
modes.description: Numbers and spaces in a Unix directory listing line.
modes.example: 6, 9 Mar 18 22:24 cd1b brw-r----- 1 root operator <<6>>, 11 Mar 18

modes.label: Snippet joins
modes.description: Ellipses or a capitalized first word where scraped web text jumps to a new snippet.
modes.example: discovery of Sāsānian murals <<...>>These motifs often figure both on surviving textiles

card.plain: It fires on punctuation and spacing in rigid data lines, like census figures or file listings, and at jumps between pasted text snippets.
